nf209c1bd65.headline: Government will reduce alcohol excise tax by 25 percent! Social Minister did not support the excise tax reduction
nf209c1bd65.summary: The Estonian government decided to reduce alcohol excise tax by 25%, potentially causing a 0.4% budget deficit next year.
nf209c1bd65.why: Tax changes affect government revenue and consumer prices, influencing economic activity and fiscal balance.
